full_description:
AWS Cognito Authentication, RBAC & Work Order Backend for Digital Twin

Project Description

We are developing TwinPro, a digital twin and O&M management platform for solar power plants.

We require a full-stack/AWS developer to implement user authentication, role-based access control and a basic plant-maintenance/work-order workflow, followed by deployment of the integrated backend on AWS.

User Hierarchy

The application will support roles such as:

Super Admin
Enterprise Admin
Portfolio Manager
Plant Manager
Engineer
Technician

Access must be restricted based on both:

Role
Assigned enterprise/portfolio/plant

For example, a technician assigned to Plant A should not automatically have access to Plant B.

Authentication Scope
AWS Cognito user pool
Login/logout
Password reset
JWT token validation
Role-based permissions
User-to-plant assignment
Protected APIs
Protected React routes
Session handling
Work Order Scope

The workflow should support:

Alarm/Issue → Work Order → Technician Assignment → Inspection/Repair → Evidence → Manager Verification → Closure

Work-order fields should include:

Work-order ID
Plant
Asset
Fault category
Priority
Description
Assigned technician
Created by
Due date
Status
Technician remarks
Manager remarks
Photos/documents
Creation timestamp
Completion timestamp
Closure status
Typical Status Flow

Open → Assigned → In Progress → Awaiting Verification → Closed

AWS Deployment Scope

Preferred architecture:

React/Amplify → Cognito → API → ECS/ECR → PostgreSQL/Aurora/RDS

Developer should:

Dockerise services.
Deploy backend.
Configure environment variables/secrets correctly.
Set up GitHub CI/CD.
Configure logging.
Prepare database backup strategy.
Document deployment.
Provide handover.
Deliverables

Milestone 1: Cognito + authentication
Milestone 2: RBAC + plant-level permissions
Milestone 3: Work-order backend/API
Milestone 4: React integration for work-order workflow
Milestone 5: AWS deployment + CI/CD + documentation

Security Requirements
No credentials hard-coded in source
Environment variables/secrets management
Passwords must not be stored by the application
API endpoints must validate authentication and permissions
User access should follow least-privilege principles
What to Include in Your Bid

Please provide:

AWS projects completed
Cognito experience
ECS/ECR experience
RBAC implementations completed
CI/CD experience
GitHub/code samples where possible

Start your proposal with “TWINPRO AWS”.

Preferred Skills

Amazon Web Services
AWS Lambda
React.js
Node.js
DevOps

Suggested Project Type

Fixed Price

Suggested Budget

₹5,000–₹10,000

Target Completion

7 days

We love the clean, structured, and institutional look of Gresham Advisory Partners ([login to view URL]).

full_description:
Connect Existing React Solar Digital Twin Frontend to Backend APIs

Project Description

We have an existing React-based digital twin frontend called TwinPro for management and monitoring of solar power plants.

Several existing screens currently obtain their information from static JSON/dummy datasets.

We require an experienced React developer to connect the existing frontend to REST APIs while maintaining the existing UI and UX.

This assignment is primarily API integration. It is NOT a UI redesign project.

Existing Application Structure

Enterprise
↓
Portfolio
↓
Plant
↓
Block
↓
Individual assets

The frontend includes dashboards, GIS layouts, KPIs, alarms, assets and other operational modules.

Scope of Work
Review existing React project.
Identify all hard-coded/static JSON data sources.
Develop central API service layer.
Replace static JSON with backend API requests.
Implement environment-based API configuration.
Integrate JWT/Cognito authentication tokens.
Connect Enterprise dashboard.
Connect Portfolio dashboard.
Connect Plant dashboard.
Connect asset details.
Connect alarm data.
Connect GIS/asset coordinates.
Add loading states.
Add API error handling.
Add empty/no-data states.
Maintain responsive behaviour.
Document API integration.
Example Change

Current architecture:

React UI → Static JSON

Required architecture:

React UI → API Service → REST Backend → Database

Screens for Initial Integration

Initial project should cover approximately:

Login/session integration
Enterprise Overview
Portfolio Overview
Plant Overview
Plant KPI cards
Alarm panel
Asset register
Asset detail
GIS/plant map data
Historical generation chart
Work-order list
Deliverables

Milestone 1: Existing-code audit + API mapping
Milestone 2: Central API service + authentication integration
Milestone 3: Enterprise/Portfolio integration
Milestone 4: Plant/Asset/Alarm integration
Milestone 5: Testing, bug fixes and documentation

Important Requirement

Do not redesign the existing TwinPro UI unless specifically requested.

We need clean, reusable code so that additional screens can subsequently be connected using the same API service architecture.

All source code must be committed to our project repository.

What to Include in Your Bid

Please provide:

Examples of React dashboards developed
Experience connecting React with REST APIs
AWS Amplify/Cognito experience
Experience with GIS/map applications, if available
GitHub/code sample

Start your proposal with “TWINPRO REACT”.

Preferred Skills

React.js
JavaScript
RESTful API
Amazon Web Services
Frontend Development

Suggested Project Type

Fixed Price

Suggested Budget

₹5,000–₹50,000

Target Completion

7 days

full_description:
A custom Gestion Commerciale Intégrée (integrated business management app) — inspired by Procom 10, built specifically for your hardware/plumbing/electrical supply business. It's a single-page React application that runs entirely in the browser on one Windows computer, with all data saved locally on that machine.

How it's built
React (single file, [login to view URL]) run through Vite as the dev server
lucide-react for icons
html2canvas + jsPDF to generate real downloadable PDF files from the on-screen documents
localStorage as the database — everything persists between sessions on that one computer, but isn't shared across machines (we discussed a shared-network version early on and deliberately dropped it in favor of single-computer use)
Core modules

Dashboard — client/supplier counts, low-stock alerts, this month's revenue, a feed of recent documents.

Clients & Suppliers — contact records (name, phone, email, address, ICE). Clicking a client's name opens their dedicated account page: every invoice they've taken, a running balance (invoiced vs. paid vs. still owed), a form to record partial payments, and buttons to print/download a full account statement PDF to hand them.

Stock (Products) — reference code, name, unit, price, quantity, reorder threshold with low-stock badges.

Catalog — a click-to-shop view of all products (built for scaling to 1000+ items via search). Clicking a product adds it to a cart; "Create Invoice" drops you straight into a new invoice pre-filled with everything you picked, so you just choose the client and save.

Sales documents — Quote (Devis) → Sales Order (Bon de Commande) → Invoice (Facture) → Credit Note (Avoir), with one-click convert between them. Stock decreases automatically when an invoice is issued, and increases back on a credit note.

Purchase documents — Purchase Order → Delivery Note (Bon de Livraison) → Purchase Invoice, same convert flow. Stock increases when a delivery note is recorded.

Every document can be previewed, printed, or downloaded as a real PDF, styled to match your actual paper documents (logo box, company name/tagline, doc-type box, item table, "Net à Payer" total pinned to the bottom of the A4 page, footer with your contact info) — and shows who created it and when.

Users & permissions
Login system: first launch creates the admin account; everyone else logs in with their own username/password
Admin manages employees from a Users page, toggling per-employee permissions: can edit records, can delete records, can create return invoices (Avoir) — off by default for new employees
Customization (admin only, in Settings)
Company info: name, tagline, logo upload, address, phone, fax, email, ICE — all shown on printed documents
Invoice Template Designer: an Excel-style panel to toggle lines between products, pick border/header/accent colors, adjust corner roundness, and choose a font — with a live shrunk preview
Language: English/French toggle (currently covers navigation and core labels — not yet every field in every screen)
A fixed App Information block crediting you (Abdellah Ouhamouch, phone, email) — hardcoded so it can't be edited from the UI
Current limitations worth knowing
Single computer only — no syncing between employee machines (this was a deliberate choice you made)
localStorage-based — if that browser's storage gets cleared, data is gone; no built-in backup/export yet
Passwords aren't encrypted — fine for keeping honest employees honest, not real security against someone technical
French translation is partial — main navigation and labels, not every screen yet

full_description:
Develop Solar SCADA / IoT Telemetry Data Ingestion Backend

Project Description

We are developing TwinPro, a digital twin and monitoring platform for solar power plants.

We require an IoT/backend developer to create a telemetry ingestion service capable of receiving operational data from solar inverters, weather stations, meters, SCBs, transformers and other plant equipment.

Initially, the system will operate using a simulated solar SCADA data generator. It will later be connected to actual solar plants.

Typical Data Points

Inverters

AC power
DC power
Daily energy
Cumulative energy
DC voltage
AC voltage
Current
Frequency
Efficiency
Temperature
Operating status

Weather Station

GHI
POA irradiance
Ambient temperature
Module temperature
Wind speed
Relative humidity

Energy Meter

Active power
Reactive power
Export energy
Import energy
Voltage
Current
Frequency
Power factor

Transformer / SCB

Equipment status
Temperature
Current
Voltage
Alarm/fault status
Scope of Work
Develop telemetry ingestion service.
Support REST/MQTT input.
Create flexible device/tag mapping.
Store timestamped data in PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB or suitable time-series architecture.
Develop 1-minute, 5-minute, hourly and daily aggregation.
Identify missing/bad data.
Store data quality flags.
Create APIs for retrieval of historical telemetry.
Build a configurable SCADA simulator.
Generate multiple days of realistic sample solar-plant data.

The simulator should recreate normal solar behaviour such as:

Zero generation at night
Increasing generation after sunrise
Midday peak
Cloud-induced fluctuations
Equipment alarms
Communication failures
Missing data
Inverter derating
Required Architecture

Device/Simulator → Ingestion API/MQTT → Tag Mapping → Raw Telemetry → Aggregation → TwinPro API

Deliverables

Milestone 1: Telemetry architecture + tag model
Milestone 2: Data ingestion API/MQTT service
Milestone 3: Time-series database implementation
Milestone 4: Solar SCADA simulator
Milestone 5: Aggregated/historical-data APIs + documentation

Important Requirement

The solution must be device-independent. We should be able to add new inverter or sensor manufacturers by configuration rather than rewriting the complete ingestion service.

What to Include in Your Bid

Please explain:

Previous IoT/SCADA projects
Experience with MQTT/Modbus
Recommended time-series database
How you would handle missing SCADA values
Whether you have worked with renewable-energy data

Start your bid with “TWINPRO SCADA”.

 Dashboard System (Master Admin, Super Admin & Agent)

 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

 SMTP Email Configuration

 Google Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

 WhatsApp QR Connection System

 WhatsApp Pairing Code Support

 WhatsApp Automation Engine

 Interactive WhatsApp Menu System

 Human Handoff & Bot Pause

 Offline Request Form

 Reply Request Management

 Business Hours Automation

 Contact Management

 User Management

 Audit Logs

 Dark & Light Theme

 Arabic & English Language Support

 Settings Management

 PM2 Production Deployment

 SSL (HTTPS) Configuration

 MySQL Database Integration

 Responsive Dashboard (Desktop & Mobile)

 Live Production Deployment

 WhatsApp Session Persistence & Auto Reconnect

 Core Programming Language: PHP 8.3-FPM

 Database: MySQL

 WhatsApp Backend Engine: Baileys (Node.js)

III. Required Tasks (Task List)

1. File Transfer Module Implementation:

 Requirement: Enable the bot to handle attachments (documents like PDFs, images, etc.) via the Baileys engine.

 Details: Develop the capability to receive files from clients and save them programmatically, as well as the platform's ability to send files to clients as part of interactive automated responses. You must ensure a secure and organized storage path architecture.

2. Voice Messages Module Implementation:

 Requirement: Support sending and receiving Voice Notes / Audio Messages.

 Details: Process WhatsApp-supported audio extensions (e.g., ogg/ptt) via Baileys so the system can save incoming voice payloads and dispatch pre-recorded voice messages to clients.

3. Full Mobile-Device Emulation & Control:

 Requirement: Upgrade the platform to possess comprehensive control capabilities that mirror the official WhatsApp mobile application.

 Details: Leverage advanced Baileys capabilities and link them to the dashboard. This includes: full group management (create, edit, add/remove members), profile control (change profile picture and 'About' status), contact synchronization, presence updates (Online, Typing), 'Delete for everyone' (Revoke messages), and handling WhatsApp Status updates.

4. Smart Alert & Notification System:

 Requirement: Build a real-time notification system connecting WhatsApp engine events to the management dashboard.

 Details: Trigger instant in-dashboard alerts for agents and managers during critical events (e.g., Human Handoff requests, Offline Requests received outside business hours, Session Drops, or system errors). Additionally, enable programmatic dispatch of "Emergency Alert Messages" via WhatsApp to pre-defined admin numbers.

5. Automated Contact Capture Module (Auto-Store):

 Requirement: Automatically capture and update details of any new user interacting with the bot in the database.

 Details: Upon receiving any new message via Baileys, programmatically extract the sender's data (JID/Phone Number, Push Name, and first/last contact timestamp). Verify against the database: insert as a new entry in the Contacts table if the user is new, or automatically update their details and Timestamp if they already exist, ensuring a fully automated CRM build without manual intervention.

 Requirement: Ensure all newly added interfaces and modifications are fully responsive across all devices (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile).

 Details: The Dashboard and chat interfaces—especially those handling files and voice messages—must adapt seamlessly to various screen sizes without layout distortion. This guarantees that agents and managers can efficiently monitor and manage the system on their smartphones.

 Requirement: Upgrade the current Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to support customized granular permissions per individual user, in addition to the primary roles (Master Admin, Super Admin, Agent).

 Details: Develop an interface and protocol allowing the Master Admin to override default role rules and assign exceptional custom permissions to a specific Agent or Super Admin (e.g., granting a specific agent the right to export contacts while denying it to others, or revoking message deletion rights from a specific admin). The system must be flexible enough to handle these user-level permission exceptions at the database level.

Please adhere strictly to the defined workflows, ensure you fully understand the current system dependencies before making modifications, and notify us immediately upon completion to proceed with testing. Best of luck.

full_description:
We are a Montréal construction and renovation company looking for a talented **UI/UX web designer with strong Wix/Wix Studio experience** to completely redesign and restructure our existing website.

The website already exists. We have branding, content and some project photography, but the current site lacks consistency, strong narrative and a smooth user experience.

We want something much simpler, more sophisticated and more memorable.

Our objective:

**Simple structure + strong art direction + excellent typography + clear narrative + smooth UX.**

We do NOT want a complicated website with unnecessary pages, custom coding or excessive animation.

## CORE CONCEPT

The company serves two audiences:

**RESIDENTIAL** — homeowners looking for renovations, additions and transformations.

**COMMERCIAL** — businesses, developers and property owners looking for construction, renovation and project-management capabilities.

This is **ONE website and ONE brand**, but Residential and Commercial should offer two different experiences.

### Main Landing Page

The main landing page should be extremely simple and brand-focused.

Conceptually:

**COMPANY GROUP**
Construction & Renovation — Montréal

**RESIDENTIAL →**
**COMMERCIAL →**

The designer determines the visual execution.

We want confidence, simplicity and a premium first impression.

## RESIDENTIAL

Residential should feel warm, aspirational, genuine and refined.

We do NOT want another generic contractor website simply organized as:

“Services / Kitchens / Bathrooms / Basements / About Us / Why Choose Us.”

We would like to explore something more customer-oriented.

One possible concept:

**What would you like to change?**

**More space**
Extensions / basements

**One important room**
Kitchens / bathrooms

**The whole home**
Complete renovations / project management

**A fresh start**
Painting / flooring / finishing

This is a strategic direction, NOT a finalized design. We want the designer to transform this idea into an elegant and intuitive experience.

Originality should come from **good thinking, typography, spacing and composition**, not expensive technical effects.

## COMMERCIAL

Commercial should feel different: cleaner, more direct and highly professional.

It should emphasize:

* Construction capabilities
* Project management
* Planning and coordination
* Reliability
* Budget/schedule control
* Credentials
* Selected work

We prefer one strong Commercial experience rather than numerous service pages.

## KEEP THE WEBSITE SMALL

This is important.

Our preliminary structure is approximately:

* Main Landing
* Residential
* Commercial
* Contact
* Possibly Projects if justified

Services, selected projects, company information and approach can potentially exist within these pages.

We do not want pages created simply because other construction companies have them.

## COMPLETELY BILINGUAL — FRENCH FIRST

The entire website must be professionally bilingual:

**French + English**

**French must be the DEFAULT language.**

Visitors must have a clearly visible **FR / EN** selector.

The English experience must be complete — no pages mixing French and English.

Navigation, buttons, forms, confirmation messages and relevant SEO information must respect the selected language.

## PHOTOGRAPHY

We currently have a limited library of professional project photography.

The design must therefore NOT depend on dozens of photographs.

Real projects must be used when work is presented as our own.

Licensed stock or carefully generated conceptual/atmospheric imagery may supplement the site when appropriate, but must never be presented as completed company projects.

## DESIGN REFERENCES

These are references, NOT websites to copy.

**OVI Construction**
[login to view URL]

We like its confidence, typography, whitespace, branding and premium perception. We do not necessarily need its level of complex animation.

**Groupe Manovra**
[login to view URL]

Very important reference. We like its simplicity, clean structure, commercial professionalism and ability to feel sophisticated without being technically complicated.

**VK Group**
[login to view URL]

We like some of its aspirational residential atmosphere, but NOT the excessive pages, long repetitive text or content-heavy structure.

Our general direction:

**OVI's confidence + Manovra's simplicity + selective aspirational residential imagery.**

## PROJECT PROCESS

### 1. UX / Structure

Review the existing website and work with us to finalize sitemap, navigation, Residential/Commercial journeys and content hierarchy.

We already have a strategic framework. We are not looking for an expensive branding exercise.

### 2. Figma

Design the new visual direction in Figma for desktop and mobile.

**The design must be approved BEFORE full Wix implementation begins.**

Approved designs should not be significantly changed during implementation without discussion.

### 3. Wix / Wix Studio

Implement the approved design on our existing Wix website.

The final website must be responsive, mobile-friendly, fast and easy for us to maintain ourselves.

### 4. Bilingual Setup

Implement and verify the complete French and English versions.

French = default.
English = selectable.

### 5. Contact Form + Lead Notifications

This is REQUIRED.

When a potential client submits a form:

* Submission must be stored correctly.
* We receive an immediate email.
* We receive an immediate phone notification.
* Ideally, we receive an SMS/text notification.
* If SMS requires a paid service, propose the simplest/lowest-cost reliable solution and disclose recurring costs BEFORE implementation.
* Customer information should be stored in Wix Contacts/CRM.
* Customer receives a professional confirmation in their selected language.
* Basic spam protection is configured.
* Everything is tested on desktop and mobile.

The workflow must work:

**Customer submits → Lead stored → Company notified immediately → Customer receives confirmation.**

### 6. QA

Final testing must include:

* Desktop/mobile/tablet
* French/English
* Navigation
* Forms and automations
* Links and contact information
* Typography/spacing
* Basic SEO
* Redirects from removed pages where required
* No placeholder or broken content

## BUDGET

**Open to proposals.**

Please provide a **fixed-price quote broken down by milestones** and disclose any recurring software/app costs.

We prefer investing in **good design and implementation** rather than unnecessary functionality.

## TO APPLY

Please provide:

1. Your **3 most relevant websites only**
2. Figma/UI/UX examples
3. Wix/Wix Studio experience
4. Responsive/mobile examples
5. Multilingual website experience
6. Wix Forms/CRM/automation experience
7. Your proposed approach
8. Timeline
9. Fixed-price quote by milestone
10. Any recurring costs

We are primarily looking for a **strong designer who is also highly competent in Wix/Wix Studio**, not simply a developer who occasionally designs.

Generic proposals will not be considered.

**To confirm you read the brief, begin your proposal with: “RESIDENTIAL / COMMERCIAL”.**

The final result should feel:

**Simple. Premium. Modern. Genuine. Professional.**

Residential visitors should feel inspired and confident.

Commercial visitors should see a capable, organized and reliable construction company.

And when either visitor contacts us, **we should know immediately.**
